sections.section: RGLN. - Baluchistan Development Authority Act (Extension to the Tribal Areas of Baluchistan) Regulation 1974
sections.description:
BALUCHISTAN DEVELOPMENT AUTHORITY ACT
BALUCHISTAN
DEVELOPMENT AUTHORITY ACT
(EXTENSION TO THE
TRIBAL AREAS OF BALUCHISTAN)
REGULATION, 1974
REGULATION II OF 1974
A Regulation to
extend the Baluchistan Development Authority Act,
1974 (Baluchistan Act
No. X of 1974), to the tribal
areas of Baluchistan
[Gazette of
Baluchistan, Extraordinary, 29th July 1974]
No. Legis. 1-11/Law/70.----The
following Regulation made by Governor of Baluchistan on the 29th July, 1974, is
hereby published for general information:-
Preamble.-Whereas it is
expedient to apply the Baluchistan Development Authority Act, 1974 (Baluchistan
Act No. X of 1974), to the tribal areas of Baluchistan;
Now, therefore, in exercise of
the Powers conferred by clause (4) of Art. 247 of the Constitution of the
Islamic Republic of Pakistan, the Governor of Baluchistan, with the prior
approval of the President, is pleased to make and promulgate the following
Regulation, namely:-
1. Short title, extent and
commencement.----(1) This Regulation may be called the Baluchistan
Development Authority Act (Extension to the Tribal Areas of Baluchistan)
Regulation, 1974.
(2) It extends to-the whole of
the tribal areas of the Province of Baluchistan.
(3) It shall be deemed to have
come into force on the 14th January, 1974.
2. Extension of Baluchistan
Development Authority Act, 1974, to the tribal areas of Baluchistan.----The
provisions of the Baluchistan Development Authority Act, 1914 (Baluchistan Act
No. X of 1974), and the rules made thereunder shall apply to the whole of the
tribal areas of the Province of Baluchistan as they apply to the other areas of
the Province.
